title: The long way to the ridge
description: A train into the hills, a walk above the clouds, and a day we never planned. Four days remembered by five people.

chapters.title: The journey before the trail
chapters.author: Mira Sen
chapters.place: From the station to the hills
chapters.body: We left before the city had properly woken up. By lunchtime the windows were open, the air was cooler, and the conversation had given way to watching the hills. The walk began long before we reached the trail.
chapters.reflection: Leave room for the getting there. It became one of our favourite parts.

chapters.title: Above the morning cloud
chapters.author: Leo Martin
chapters.body: The first climb was quiet. We kept stopping, partly for breath and partly because the view changed every few minutes. At the ridge, the cloud lifted just long enough to show us how far we had come.
chapters.reflection: A shorter day gave everyone time to walk at their own pace.

chapters.title: A day with nowhere to be
chapters.author: Dev Raman
chapters.body: Rain settled in overnight. We put the boots by the door and let the day be small: tea, a late breakfast, a conversation that ran into the afternoon. There is no track for this day. It belongs in the story all the same.
chapters.reflection: The unplanned rest mattered as much as the distance.

chapters.title: Taking the hills home
chapters.author: Noor Jayasinghe
chapters.body: The bags were a little damp and the bus was late. We traded photographs on the way back, each of us remembering a different version of the same four days. This is where those versions meet.
chapters.reflection: Write down the little details before they become the things you wish you remembered.
